projects.items.name: data2bids
projects.items.summary: AI question answering for construction bid teams. It connects to Google Drive, digitizes PDFs, drawings, spreadsheets and photos, and answers with the source file and page.

highlights.title: Drive sync
highlights.body: Read-only Google Drive connection. Folders stay where they are.

highlights.title: Document pipeline
highlights.body: OCR, chunking, embeddings and GraphRAG in a queue-driven worker on Kubernetes.

highlights.title: Cited answers
highlights.body: Every answer names its source file and page. Every query is scoped to one company.

highlights.title: Claude and ChatGPT
highlights.body: A custom MCP server lets both assistants query a project over OAuth.

images: Product demo of data2bids: connecting Google Drive, then asking Claude and ChatGPT questions about a bid
A cited answer about a bid deadline inside ChatGPT

highlights.title: Backlog

highlights.title: Now playing
highlights.body: Track what you play and record your impressions.

highlights.title: Reviews

highlights.title: One backend
